content.text:
fristenmanagement              state=exited/1       /docs=000
berichtskonfigurator           state=exited/3       /docs=000
risikohinweis-service          state=exited/3       /docs=000
decision-log-store-service     state=exited/1       /docs=000
ki-guv-feedback                state=exited/3       /docs=000
ki-guv-ai-testing              state=exited/3       /docs=000
graph-api                      state=exited/1       /docs=000
dokumentensuche                state=running/0      /docs=200
kommentar-service              state=exited/1       /docs=000
ki-guv-explainability          state=exited/3       /docs=000

observation.command:
cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/probe.sh <<'EOF'
svcs=(fristenmanagement berichtskonfigurator risikohinweis-service decision-log-store-service ki-guv-feedback ki-guv-ai-testing graph-api dokumentensuche kommentar-service ki-guv-explainability)
i=0
for svc in "${svcs[@]}"; do
  i=$((i+1))
  docker rm -f pb-$svc >/dev/null 2>&1
  docker run -d --name pb-$svc -p $((19000+i)):8000 $svc:latest >/dev/null 2>&1
done
sleep 30
i=0
for svc in "${svcs[@]}"; do
  i=$((i+1))
  st=$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Status}}/{{.State.ExitCode}}' pb-$svc 2>/dev/null)
  code=$(curl -s -m 4 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:$((19000+i))/docs 2>/dev/null)
  printf "%-30s state=%-14s /docs=%s\n" "$svc" "$st" "$code"
done
EOF
bash /tmp/probe.sh
